message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, each coin can land either heads (H) or tails (T).  
The total number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0 to 3**:

| Number of Heads | Example Outcomes |
|-----------------|------------------|
| 0 | T T T |
| 1 | H T T, T H T, T T H |
| 2 | H H T, H T H, T H H |
| 3 | H H H |

So the possible counts of heads are **0, 1, 2, or 3**.
